title: Drawer
summary: A bottom drawer with a grab handle is a MonarchBottomSheet with its default drag handle, which opens partially expanded when its content is tall. Monarch ships nothing.
whenToUse: On a phone, for content the person may want to see partly or fully: a list of options, details of a map pin, a short form that should leave the screen visible above it.
whenNotToUse: For a task that must be finished before going on use MonarchDialog (see dialog). For navigation between the app's destinations use a navigation drawer (see sidebar-nav).
api: @Composable fun MonarchBottomSheet(onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, dismissible: Boolean = true, showHandle: Boolean = true, fullyExpanded: Boolean = true, fullWidthContent: Boolean = false, content: @Composable MonarchBottomSheetScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun BottomSheetDefaults.DragHandle(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, width: Dp = SheetDefaults.DragHandleWidth, height: Dp = SheetDefaults.DragHandleHeight, shape: Shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.extraLarge, color: Color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)

states.name: partially expanded
states.description: A tall drawer opens at half the screen; dragging the handle up expands it.

states.name: expanded
states.description: The drawer covers most of the screen and its content scrolls.

states.name: drag to close off
states.description: With dismissible = false the drawer does not follow drags; close it with a button or back.

appearance: The drawer uses the raised background role with Monarch's extra-large top corners, the drag handle the muted text role (Material onSurfaceVariant), and the overlay scrim role behind it, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web Drawer is a bottom panel with a grab handle and dragToClose, built on the web Sheet. On Android it is MonarchBottomSheet: the handle is its built-in Monarch handle, dragToClose={false} is dismissible = false, and partial expansion is fullyExpanded = false. iOS uses the system sheet with detents.
accessibility: System behavior: the drag handle is a button that TalkBack reads with actions to expand, collapse and close, so the drawer can be moved without a drag gesture.
System behavior: the drawer is announced when it opens and back closes it.
Rows inside keep their own 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: A drawer with short content opens fully expanded: there is no half state for content shorter than half the screen.
Lazy lists inside scroll with the drawer's nested scrolling; do not put a verticalScroll column around a LazyColumn.
